Name: PIF - Personal Rooms
Author: DeLiXxN
Description:
[center][font=Verdana][size=3][b]Setup[/b]
[/size]1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
2. Unpack PIF in your Mods Folder
3. Unpack your content pack in your Mods Folder
4. Make sure you've installed all requirements of the content pack
5. Start the game using the SMAPI Launcher

[size=3][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

All Players need to have both PIF and matching content packs installed.
Mismatching versions will cause issues. It is recommended to keep your mods updated to the latest version.

[color=#6aa84f][size=5]✔[/size][/color] [size=4]Singleplayer
[color=#6aa84f][size=5]✔[/size][/color] [size=4]Multiplayer[/size][size=4][/size][/size]
[color=#6aa84f][size=5]✔[/size][/color] [size=4]Gamepad[/size]


[size=3][b]⭐ New Items ⭐[/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15132/15132-1720101102-615220912.png[/img]﻿

[/size]All new Items can be bought from a Magician in the tunnels west of the bus stop


[size=3]🌌 [b]Door of Dimensions[/b] 🌌[/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15132/15132-1710340746-719313292.png[/img]

Eac﻿h of these doors grants access to a different personal room.
They can be used in any decorable location and are unique to each player.
You choose what room design you want based on the content packs you have installed.
1.6's Decorative Doors can be used as Dimension Doors.


[b][size=3]✨ Space Time Synchronizer ✨[/size][/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15132/15132-1710340972-1067992699.png[/img]
Drinking this will synchronize your personal room with Pelican Town's date.
It requires you to be in the room you want to synchronize and will only work on your own rooms.
This is useful when you haven't played multiplayer in a while.﻿


[b][size=3]🌀 Void Seal Liquid 🌀[/size][/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15132/15132-1712268147-1053800151.png[/img]

Drinking the Void Seal Liquid will reset your personal room.
Everything inside will be irreversibly deleted, allowing you to select a new room design.
It requires you to be in the room you want to reset and will only work on your own rooms.


[b]🌷 Painting of the Season 🌷[/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15132/15132-1710341308-1340726965.png[/img]﻿
This painting will show the current date and season of the room it has been placed in.


[b][b]🗝️[/b] Void Key 🗝️[/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15132/15132-1718445036-346097786.png[/img]﻿
Locks and unlocks access to your room in multiplayer.
You can choose between Unlocked/Locked When Offline (Default)/Locked


[size=4][b]For Content Creators
[/b][/size]- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

If you'd like to add more room designs feel free to just edit the Cozy Sunroom Farm and skim through the documentation.
